name: llama31_8b_grid_v2_owncalib
description: Llama-3.1-8B grid, calibration-unified: ALL calibration-based methods derive from the same corpus (198 GPQA-Diamond prompts, ours). Re-runs the rotation-dependent methods (int2, vq2) on rotations recomputed from the full 198-prompt dump; calibration-free methods (bf16, turbo, quarot, naive) are reused from grid/ v1 unchanged.

calibration.k_codebook_recipe: capture_gpqa_concat (same 198 prompts, 8x64K cycled) -> train_group_vq_alloc --grouping stratified --allocation flat --bpc 2 --pertoken-norm -> make_fp8 e5m2 (rotation-independent: bundle carries its own forward map)

int2.notes: production OSCAR path; clips remain the authors' Qwen-tuned defaults (recorded limitation, not recalibrated)

vq2.notes: K tier = codebook (unchanged, rotation-independent); V tier + windows = int2 path, so V rides the new rotations

protocol.niah: greedy (T=0), 1 rollout/row, gen cap 128, accuracy = mean RULER string_match over 8 subtasks
protocol.reasoning_code: avg@5 (5 independent seed-sets, per-seed scoring, mean +/- std), math-verify / answer-letter / test-execution scorers
protocol.serving: token pool 140000/GPU, CUDA graphs, MAX_REQS=24; mixed-KV band 64 sink + 256 recent bf16 for int2/vq2
